mission_02: Well done! You have implemented both standard and modified Z-score outlier detection methods. The standard Z-score provides a statistically principled approach for normally distributed data, with the 3-sigma rule capturing the well-known 99.7% coverage. The modified Z-score, using median and MAD, offers robustness when outliers are present in sufficient numbers to distort the mean and standard deviation. You observed how the two methods can produce different results, with the modified version being more reliable when the dataset contains multiple outliers. Z-score methods are computationally efficient, easy to interpret, and provide clear statistical justification for outlier classification, making them a go-to choice for initial exploratory analysis.
